evals.name: never-rule-review-fix
evals.expected_output: Corrected CSS that eliminates every NEVER-rule violation: no transition:all, no ease-in, no layout-property animation, no scale(0) entry, no gradient text, no >1px side-stripe border.
evals.baseline_failure: Baseline typically tightens the transition duration and keeps ease-in, keeps the width/padding hover animation, and praises the gradient title as a nice touch.
expectations: The corrected CSS does not contain 'transition: all' — transitions name specific properties
No 'ease-in' timing function remains on any entry animation or transition (replaced by ease-out or a cubic-bezier)
The hover effect no longer animates width or padding — it uses transform (and/or opacity) instead
The entry keyframes no longer start from scale(0); they start from a near-1 scale (e.g. scale(0.95)) with opacity
The gradient text on the title is removed or replaced with solid color/weight-based emphasis
The >1px border-left accent stripe is removed or replaced (full border, background tint, or ≤1px)

evals.name: anti-slop-generation
evals.prompt: Build a hero section (single HTML file with embedded CSS) for 'Loomline', an AI writing assistant startup's landing page. Make it look great.
evals.expected_output: A committed, non-generic hero: a named non-default font, a dominant palette that is not the AI-category purple reflex, no gradient text, no identical 3-column card grid, real CTA interaction states.
evals.baseline_failure: Baseline typically produces the AI-startup reflex: purple/violet gradient palette, gradient text on the headline, Inter/system font, three identical feature cards.
expectations: The dominant accent/primary color is not purple or violet (no purple-family hex/oklch as the lead accent)
A specific display or body font is named that is not Inter, Roboto, Arial, Open Sans, or a bare system-ui stack
No gradient text anywhere (no background-clip: text technique)
The hero does not contain an identical 3-column card grid
The CTA button has explicit hover and focus-visible styles
